trace_line_form: Each event line begins with the exact schema prefix, one space, then its event fields.
multiple_blocks: Allowed. Retained in order; selected is block index zero, matching producer command order. Timestamps are not used to identify commands.
duration: Unsigned decimal u64 nanoseconds. Checked phase sum must equal END elapsed_ns without overflow.
unrelated_stderr: Allowed outside trace rows, including between rows. Trace-looking malformed or unmatched rows are rejected.
output: JSON includes all validated blocks, selected_block_index=0, and selected as the first block.
